message: Sounds like your cat's have inherited some of our cats' spirits. We have two black and white cats which are both semi-feral, one more than the other. When Ida got caught in a plastic bag like your describe, it was insanity with three other cats ending up freaking out as well. I'm just glad she didn't have a bum knee to boot. Cats, don't you love how they rule your life, even when they don't? By the way, I'm sorta in your neighborhood: Charlottesville, VA today. Back to D.C. on Friday.
